caption: Someone throws a snowball into the air, it breaks apart during flight.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: Someone throws a snowball into the air, it breaks apart during flight. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The snowball must be thrown upward with sufficient force to leave a visible arc against the sky.
The snowball must visibly disintegrate into smaller fragments while airborne, indicating structural failure.
The fragments must remain suspended in the air for a brief period before falling back to the snow-covered ground.
The person throwing the snowball must remain in the same position, maintaining the context of the scene.
